Players Committee card image of [[Captain Rex, 501st Legion (Holo AI)]] (original printing), game text: “Your clones deploy -1 here. While at an [Episode I] battleground site, adds one battle destiny. Permanent weapon is •Twin Blasters (may target a character for free; draw two destiny; target hit and forfeit -3 if total destiny -2 > defense value).”
